title: Add reusable knowledge skills and repository understanding
what: Implement scoped skills, cross-session memory, correction and deletion, repository indexing and codebase answers as distinct user-facing behaviors. Session transcripts alone do not satisfy these capabilities.

acceptance.text: Relevant repository skills and instructions are discovered and applied with provenance
An authorized correction is available in a new session and can be removed
Knowledge from one resource scope does not leak to another
Codebase answers cite current repository evidence without starting an editing task
Acceptance covers stale indexes, revocation and deleted knowledge
